Job Description:

Compensation & Benefits

  • Pay: $19.00 – $21.00 per hour

  • Incentives: periodic SPIFFs and performance-based incentives throughout the year

  • Equipment provided: laptop, docking station, and dual monitors

  • Full benefits package, 401(k) with employer match, and a discount on RyderShares

Position Details

  • Location: Remote — candidates based anywhere are welcome to apply. Local candidates (Atlanta, GA area) will have the option to complete in-person onboarding and training at the service center, which is the preferred approach when possible.

  • Schedule: Standard business hours, Monday through Friday

  • Work style: Primarily email-based (~70% email, ~20% Microsoft Teams/video, ~10% phone). A strong digital communicator will thrive here.

JOIN A TEAM THAT ACTUALLY HAS YOUR BACK.

This isn’t just a job — it’s a seat on a tight-knit, highly collaborative team of ten where everyone covers for each other, works in shared files daily, and shows up for one another like family. The team culture is open, communicative, and genuinely supportive. If you’re detail-oriented, great with people, and thrive in a fast-moving environment where there’s always something to do, you’ll fit right in.

As an Inside Vehicle Sales Representative, you’ll be the backbone of the Inside Sales operation — managing the sales process from start to finish, supporting customers through their buying experience, and keeping everything compliant, accurate, and moving.

Why Ryder?

Ryder isn’t just a great place to grow your career, it’s a company that has been recognized time and again for excellence, integrity and its commitment to people:

  • One of the Most Trustworthy Companies in America — Newsweek

  • America’s Best Large Employers — Forbes

  • World’s Most Admired Companies — Fortune Magazine

  • Top Company for Women to Work for in Transportation — Women in Trucking

  • Overdrive Award — General Motors

  • Food Logistics’ Top 3PL Award — SDC EXEC

  • Reader’s Choice Excellence Awards — Inbound Logistics

  • Top Women to Watch in Transportation

  • Supplier Environmental Excellence Award — Verizon

Job Summary

The Inside Vehicle Sales Representative serves as frontline support for the Inside Sales Vehicle Sales Manager. You will collaborate across Sales, Marketing, Operations and Asset Management to make the customer buying experience as smooth and efficient as possible. This role is equal parts administrative precision and customer engagement — the job is never the same twice, and there’s always something to do.

What You’ll Do

Sales Administration & Processing

Manage the end-to-end sales process including titling, licensing and legal sale documents. Maintain cash logs, collect funds accurately and timely, and ensure all mandatory compliance requirements are met (Sarbanes-Oxley, Safety STAR Program and related initiatives). Work closely with the Inside Sales Vehicle Sales Manager to keep sales processing efficient and on schedule. Maintain vehicle sales compliance with local, state, federal and other regulatory agencies.

Customer Experience

Work directly with prospective and established customers to gather all applicable information needed to reduce processing time and enhance their overall experience. Communicate proactively via email and phone to build and expand customer relationships. Bring energy, organization and genuine care to every interaction.

Sales & Marketing Support

Structure all ancillary products (Finance and Extended Warranty) to meet customer needs and fulfill Ryder’s expectations. Support the Inside Vehicle Sales Manager in maximizing sales time by streamlining support activities and improving current processes.

Team Collaboration

This team works in a live, shared file environment — when someone is out, others step in and cover seamlessly. You’ll need to be comfortable working collaboratively in real time, maintaining file accuracy and communicating clearly with teammates throughout the day.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Maximize sales time by providing responsive, accurate sales support to the Inside Vehicle Sales Manager

  • Ensure Sarbanes-Oxley compliance across all required areas

  • Streamline and improve sales processing activities on an ongoing basis

  • Perform other duties as assigned

What We’re Looking For

We hire for aptitude, attitude and attention to detail. Backgrounds in medical/pharmacy, food service or any role requiring precision and customer focus tend to translate well here. The right person is organized, personable, tech-comfortable and ready to be a real contributor on a close team.

raw.description:
About Nucs AI

Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.

We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning—building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice.

Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity—moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves.

The Opportunity

Nucs AI is entering a pivotal phase—our products are being validated in clinical settings, partnerships are accelerating, and we’re preparing for commercial launch. This role is for someone who can build our go-to-market engine from the ground up, leveraging deep existing relationships across medical imaging, nuclear medicine, radioligand therapy, and AI-driven healthcare.

This is a foundational commercial hire. You’ll own the full sales cycle across a wide range of deal sizes and customer types—from closing focused product deployments with independent imaging centers to securing large-scale enterprise agreements with pharmaceutical companies and hospital networks. You bring a multilayered sales approach and understand that the motion for a $100K imaging center deal is fundamentally different from a multi-year pharma collaboration, and you’re equally effective at both.

You’re a builder who thrives in early-stage environments and brings a strong existing network to activate from day one. You’re open to new tools and innovative sales approaches—including AI-augmented prospecting and outreach—but you ground everything in proven fundamentals. You carry yourself with the same polish, credibility, and authentic conviction as the best in healthcare commercial leadership, and you’re motivated by the mission as much as the market opportunity.

What You’ll Do

Commercial Strategy & Pipeline Development

  • Define and execute Nucs AI’s go-to-market strategy across pharmaceutical, clinical, and health system channels

  • Build and manage a qualified sales pipeline targeting pharma partners, imaging networks, academic medical centers, and independent imaging facilities

  • Develop and refine positioning, messaging, and value propositions tailored to each customer segment and deal size

  • Map market channels and develop segment-specific sales motions—understanding the distinct dynamics of pharma enterprise sales, hospital system procurement, and SMB clinical sales

  • Leverage AI tools, modern sales platforms, and innovative prospecting methods alongside traditional relationship-driven selling

Multilayered Sales Execution

  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles with pharmaceutical companies and large health systems from initial engagement through contract execution

  • Execute efficient, high-velocity sales processes for smaller clinical customers and imaging centers

  • Adapt deal structures, pricing models, and engagement approaches to match the scale and sophistication of each customer

  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders at pharma companies, hospital systems, and key opinion leaders in nuclear medicine and oncology

Network Activation & Market Presence

  • Bring and activate an existing network of relationships across healthcare—doctors, hospital administrators, pharma executives, imaging center operators, and key opinion leaders

  • Represent Nucs AI at industry conferences, advisory boards, and partner meetings with executive presence and clinical credibility

  • Build Nucs AI’s commercial reputation through authentic, trust-based engagement—selling the big vision without making noise

  • Provide market intelligence on competitive landscape, customer needs, reimbursement trends, and emerging opportunities in theranostics and imaging AI

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with the medical and product teams to ensure customer insights feed directly into roadmap decisions

  • Collaborate with the Partnership Director on account strategy where sales and partnership relationships intersect

  • Work with leadership on pricing, partnership structures, and reimbursement strategy

  • Collaborate with the CEO to shape and evolve the commercial strategy as the company scales

Requirements

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of commercial experience in medical imaging, theranostics, medical AI, nuclear medicine, or oncology sales, with a strong track record of closing deals ranging from SMB product sales to large enterprise partnerships

  • An established, activatable network across medical imaging, nuclear medicine, radioligand therapy, oncology, or adjacent healthcare markets—you know the people and they know you

  • Demonstrated ability to sell across multiple layers of the market: pharma enterprise, hospital systems, and smaller clinical facilities

  • Strong understanding of healthcare market channels, procurement dynamics, and the distinct sales motions required at different customer scales

  • Experience building a commercial function at an early-stage or growth-stage company—not just executing an existing playbook, but creating one

  • Open-minded and forward-thinking about sales process innovation; comfortable leveraging AI tools, modern platforms, and creative outreach alongside traditional relationship selling

  • Elite communication and executive presence; authentic, credible, and compelling in any room from an imaging center conference room to a pharma boardroom

  • Builder’s mentality with high tenacity and zero ego—motivated by what the company achieves, not personal credit

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, life sciences, or related field

Bonus Points

  • Direct experience in PSMA, PET/CT, or radioligand therapy markets

  • Familiarity with SaMD, FDA/CE regulatory pathways, and reimbursement dynamics

  • Experience at a Series A–B stage healthcare or AI company that scaled through early commercial traction

  • A portfolio of relationships you can speak to concretely—who you know, how you’ll engage them, and what you’ll do in the first 90 days

  • MBA or advanced degree in a relevant discipline

Why Nucs AI

  • Mission with real impact – Your work directly improves how cancer patients are diagnosed and treated.

  • Ground-floor opportunity – Early-stage company, meaningful equity, and outsized influence on the direction we take.

  • World-class collaborators – Work alongside leading oncologists, nuclear medicine physicians, and AI researchers globally.

  • Massive market tailwinds – Radioligand therapy and AI-driven oncology are multi-billion dollar growth markets.

  • Autonomy and flexibility – Remote-first, flexible working. We hire great people and trust them to deliver.

  • Equity upside – Competitive equity package. We’re building something big and want you to share in it.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a brief note on why this role and Nucs AI excite you.

Equal Opportunity

Nucs AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

What We Do

At Outsource Access, we help franchise owners and multi-location businesses keep their operations running smoothly. We don’t just troubleshoot hardware and software—we make sure technical glitches never stand in the way of a store's ability to serve its customers.

How You’ll Make a Difference

  • Ensuring Business Continuity: You don’t just fix routers; you keep the doors "virtually" open by resolving internet, VOIP, and POS connectivity issues before they impact the bottom line.

  • Simplifying the Complex: You bridge the gap between technical jargon and store operations, guiding non-technical staff through hardware setups and system checks with patience and clarity.

  • Ownership of the Solution: You don’t just pass the buck; you own every ticket from initial report to final resolution, diagnosing whether a problem is a user error, a vendor bug, or a hardware failure.

  • Strengthening the Infrastructure: You act as a vital link between stores and vendors, providing clear documentation and evidence to escalate complex issues and ensure long-term stability for every location.


Requirements

Is This You?

  • A Diagnostic Detective: You have a natural knack for root-cause analysis across networking (IP, DNS, DHCP), hardware, and SaaS platforms, and you love the "aha!" moment of a solved case.

  • The Calm in the Storm: You can lead a frustrated store manager through a troubleshooting checklist during a busy shift while remaining professional, composed, and helpful.

  • A Documentation Pro: You understand that a job isn't done until it’s tracked, managed, and documented in the helpdesk system for future reference and team knowledge.

  • Tech-Savvy: You are proficient with remote desktop tools (TeamViewer, AnyDesk), ticketing systems (Zendesk, Jira), and have a solid grasp of firewalls and retail technology.

  • Your Home Office: You have a dedicated, quiet workspace with a reliable high-speed internet connection and a dependable power backup to ensure seamless daily operations.


Benefits

You’re not just taking a job — you’re stepping into a role where your growth, security, and peace of mind actually matter. Here is the total package we’ve built for you:

Your Wellness & Security Health & Wellness — Covered: You get comprehensive HMO coverage with a top provider so you can focus on work without worrying about medical bills.

Support You Can Count On: We take care of all government-mandated benefits, so everything is handled properly and on time.

Your Financial Rewards Performance Incentives: Bring results — and you’ll see it rewarded. Simple as that.

Premium Pay: When you put in the time, we honor it. You receive Overtime Pay for extra miles and Night Differential for supporting the team during late hours.

raw.description:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

We are seeking a Sr Revenue Enablement Manager - Technical Sales to own and manage our Enablement programs for our Solutions Engineers (SEs) and Customer Success Engineers (CSEs). In this role, you will play a key part in driving the technical and customer-facing effectiveness of these teams. Your focus will be on onboarding and equipping SEs and CSEs to deliver compelling customer demos, run successful proofs of value (PoVs), understand product licensing, sizing, and pricing, and selling the entire Cribl portfolio, with a concerted focus on emerging products including Search and Lake.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Design, implement, and manage enablement programs to help SEs and CSEs deliver customer demos and execute successful proofs of value with confidence.
  • Expanding and evolving the SE and CSE onboarding program from design to in-person delivery.
  • Provide comprehensive enablement on our storage and analysis solutions, product licensing, sizing, competitive positioning/trap-setting, and pricing models to ensure technical teams can effectively position Cribl's entire portfolio.
  • Develop and deliver enablement content and workshops to support technical discovery processes and new customer value messaging.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. Product, SE Leadership, Product & Technical Marketing, Enablement) to align enablement initiatives with product launches, ensuring SEs and CSEs are equipped to communicate new features effectively.
  • Partner with technical leadership to identify knowledge gaps and develop targeted training to enhance technical and customer-facing skills.
  • Monitor and analyze the effectiveness of enablement programs through engagement metrics, stakeholder feedback, and leading business indicators to drive continuous improvement.
  • Leverage AI tools and agentic workflows for program development, practical application, lab development, and just-in-time enablement.
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours


If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • 7+ years of experience in combined technical sales enablement, technical training, and/or Solutions Engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience working in a customer-facing Technical Sales role, preferably in the enterprise SaaS industry and strong familiarity with the IT telemetry and observability space.
  • Proven ability to design and deliver complex technical enablement programs that drive measurable outcomes, leveraging AI as a teammate.
  • Strong program management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities simultaneously.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into actionable learning.
  • Experience collaborating across departments, including Sales, Product, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success teams.
  • Experience working with demo platforms and tools and writing demo instructions for technical sales audiences.
  • Self-starter with a strategic mindset, attention to detail, and a drive for continuous improvement.

The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

Base Salary Range
$137,400—$180,000 USD

Bring Your Whole Self
Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you’ll ever meet at cribl.io/about-us.

raw.title: Full-Stack Developer / Shopify Expert (eCommerce CRO Focus)
raw.excerpt: Company OverviewPearl West is a leading eCommerce investment and operating group specializing in acquiring, optimizing, and scaling premium brands.
raw.description:
Company Overview

Pearl West is a leading eCommerce investment and operating group specializing in acquiring, optimizing, and scaling premium brands. Our mission is to build and grow standout online businesses, and our websites are at the heart of delivering an exceptional customer experience.

As we continue to expand our digital capabilities, we're looking for a driven, results-focused Full-Stack Developer / Shopify Expert to take ownership of our site performance and conversion rates. This is an opportunity to work directly on high-traffic Shopify stores, make fast, meaningful changes, and directly impact revenue.

Role Overview

The Full-Stack Developer / Shopify Expert will be responsible for proactively identifying, testing, and implementing improvements to our Shopify storefronts and landing pages with a sharp focus on boosting conversion rates, site speed, and customer experience. This is not a hands-off, request-only position — we’re seeking someone who lives and breathes optimization and thrives in a fast-paced, ownership-driven environment.

Your success will be measured by tangible improvements to conversion rates, customer experience scores, and overall site performance metrics.

This is a full-time, remote role, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere while staying closely aligned with our growth-focused team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and implement front-end and back-end improvements to Shopify-based websites and landing pages
  • Run A/B tests, user experience optimizations, and CRO experiments independently
  • Optimize page speed, mobile responsiveness, and checkout flow performance
  • Build custom features, sections, and pages within Shopify’s Liquid framework and via third-party apps as needed
  • Analyze site metrics, heatmaps, and customer behavior tools to proactively surface opportunities for improvement
  • Work closely with design, marketing, and product teams to translate ideas into functional, tested, high-performance web solutions
  • Stay up to date on Shopify platform updates, app ecosystem changes, and eCommerce CRO best practices
  • Maintain clean, well-documented code and follow internal development workflows
  • Track, report, and iterate based on the results of tests and site improvement

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Conversion Rate Lift – Measurable improvement in store conversion rates over baseline
  • Site Speed Performance – Maintain or improve core web vitals and page load times
  • Implementation Velocity – Speed of independently completing and deploying optimizations
  • Testing Cadence – Number of proactive A/B tests and optimization initiatives launched per quarter
  • Bug Resolution Time – Timely identification and resolution of site issues
  • Documentation and Code Quality – Maintain clean, organized, and well-commented code for handoffs and scalin

Success Benchmarks (30-60-90 Days)

First 30 Days

  • Complete onboarding on brand sites, tech stack, and optimization priorities
  • Audit existing Shopify setups and propose immediate quick-win improvements
  • Take ownership of resolving minor site issues and performance bugs
  • Launch your first A/B test or optimization project with measurable results
  • Implement key CRO improvements to landing pages or product pages

First 60 Days

  • Collaborate with marketing on a conversion-focused landing page refresh
  • Deliver measurable conversion rate improvements from your initiatives
  • Establish a consistent optimization and testing pipeline
  • Become the go-to technical resource for Shopify development and CRO implementatio

Required Skills & Qualifications

Must-Have Skills:

  • 3+ years of hands-on Shopify development experience
  • Proficiency in Liquid, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Shopify APIs
  • Experience with Shopify theme customization, app integrations, and custom section builds
  • Proven track record of driving measurable eCommerce conversion rate improvements
  • Strong understanding of website performance optimization and core web vitals
  • Ability to independently run A/B tests, analyze results, and iterate
  • Detail-oriented with clean, organized coding practices
  • Proactive, driven, and ownership-focused — thrives without constant oversight

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience with Klaviyo, Google Analytics, and heatmapping tools (e.g., Clarity, Hotjar, Lucky Orange)
  • Familiarity with headless Shopify setups or Shopify Hydrogen
  • UI/UX design skills or ability to collaborate closely with design teams
  • Experience in eCommerce growth marketing environment

Who Should Apply

Apply if you:

  • Love working in fast-paced, high-ownership eCommerce environments
  • Constantly look for ways to improve site performance and conversions
  • Prefer proactively testing ideas over waiting for requests
  • Are organized, self-directed, and results-focused

Do not apply if you:

  • Require constant hand-holding or micromanagement
  • Prefer working reactively instead of proactively seeking improvements
  • Lack eCommerce experience or familiarity with Shopify

Why Join Pearl West

  • Own Your Impact – Work on high-traffic brands where your improvements directly influence business performance
  • Growth-Driven Environment – Join a results-obsessed, testing-centric team
  • Remote-First Culture – Work from anywhere with flexible hours
  • Learn and Scale – Stay on the cutting edge of Shopify and eCommerce CRO trends

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: TBA (commensurate with experience)
  • Bonus Structure: Performance-based bonuses tied to conversion improvements and project delivery
  • Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
  • Health & Wellness Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, mental health support
  • Additional Perks: Flexible PTO, company retreats, learning stipends

Application Process

  1. Submit Your Application – Send your resume, portfolio, and a short note about your favorite CRO project you’ve worked on
  2. Technical Assessment – Complete a brief code challenge and CRO scenario review
  3. Screening Call – Meet with our hiring manager to discuss your experience and fit
  4. Final Interview – Meet with leadership and marketing leads to review priorities and vision

raw.description:
Company Description

Swiftly is on a mission to help cities move more efficiently. We are the leading transit data platform for agencies to share real-time passenger information, manage day-to-day operations, and improve service performance. Today, over 200 transit agencies in 12 countries – including LA Metro, MARTA, SEPTA, and MBTA – rely on Swiftly to improve on-time performance by up to 40% and increase passenger information accuracy by up to 50%. The result is better service reliability, increased ridership, and more efficient transit operations.
Even though Swiftly's HQ office is located in San Francisco, CA, we are open to candidates in most locations across the U.S. as well as Ontario and British Columbia, Canada. At this time we are unable to provide Visa sponsorship.

About the Role

Swiftly is seeking an exceptional Sales Manager, SMB to lead and develop our SMB Account Executive team. This is a management role focused on building, coaching, and developing a high-performing sales team — ideal for a sales leader who thrives on developing reps, driving accountability, and winning in the public-sector transit market. We're in a period of growth and are building the go-to-market team that will define our next chapter. If you're passionate about developing talent, winning in a high-velocity SMB sales environment, and making public transit better for millions of riders, we want to talk to you.

As Sales Manager, SMB, you will lead a team of 5 SMB Account Executives driving new logo acquisition with small and mid-size transit agencies across North America. Your AEs build and manage territory plans, prospect a significant share of their own pipeline, run discovery calls and platform demos, build ROI-driven business cases, and guide government agencies through procurement to close — typically on 3 to 8 month sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and government procurement processes. You'll be responsible for hiring, onboarding, coaching, and developing these reps while setting the coaching rhythm, building pipeline strategy, and ensuring the team executes with discipline using the SPICED methodology. You'll also partner with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to align on strategy and improve the buyer experience.

Sales at Swiftly

Our Sales team is responsible for introducing Swiftly's platform to transit agencies and helping them understand how our real-time data, historical insights, and operational analytics can transform their service. We sell to government agencies with consultative sales cycles that require thorough discovery, strong relationships, and a genuine passion for improving public transit. Every deal matters — not just for revenue, but because each new agency means better service for the riders who depend on it.

To ensure we are making an impact throughout the sales process, we use a value-driven sales methodology. Our GTM teams are trained on the SPICED methodology, which serves as a blueprint for achieving sales targets, and we expect our sales managers to coach and reinforce it across their teams.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership and Coaching

  • Recruit, onboard, and develop a high-performing team of SMB Account Executives.
  • Establish and maintain a coaching rhythm: regular 1:1s, call reviews, deal reviews, and skills development sessions.
  • Set clear performance expectations and hold the team accountable to activity metrics, pipeline targets, and quota attainment.
  • Foster a culture of learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement across the team.

Pipeline and Revenue

  • Own the team's pipeline generation strategy, ensuring AEs prospect approximately 50 to 60% of their own pipeline through outbound calling, email campaigns, and tools such as LinkedIn.
  • Drive disciplined territory planning and account prioritization across the SMB segment.
  • Support AEs in navigating public-sector deals with typical 3 to 8 month sales cycles, multiple stakeholders, and government procurement processes.
  • Actively join AEs on discovery calls, demos, and business case development when needed.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline reporting in Salesforce; provide weekly forecast updates to leadership using Swiftly's forecast methodology.
  • Achieve and exceed team revenue goals.

Process and Strategy

  • Champion and enforce the SPICED sales methodology across the team.
  • Coach the team on identifying and mitigating deal risk, partnering with leadership, internal partners, and executives as needed.
  • Oversee Swiftly's responses to public solicitations within your team's territories, with the support of our internal procurement team.
  • Represent Swiftly at industry conferences (APTA, TransITech, state transit associations) and coach your team on event strategy.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to refine messaging, share market feedback, and improve the buyer experience.
  • Lead the adoption of AI-assisted and modern sales workflows that improve prospecting efficiency and sales effectiveness.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with at least 3 years in a frontline sales management role.
  • Experience scaling an SMB sales team is a strong plus.
  • Proven track record of leading teams to meet or exceed quota in a new-logo sales environment.
  • Strong coaching instincts — you develop reps, not just manage them.
  • Experience with consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and procurement processes.
  • Comfortable with government or public-sector sales; transit industry experience is a plus but not required.
  • Proficient with Salesforce, Gong Engage, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and modern sales tools.
  • Excellent communication skills — you can lead a team meeting, run a deal review, and present to executives with equal confidence.
  • Willingness to travel for conferences, team events, and strategic customer meetings.

Pay Range

In accordance with pay transparency laws, the approximate salary ranges for this position are listed below. These ranges represent the anticipated low and high end of the salary. Actual salaries will vary based on final role leveling, relevant experience, and geographic location. Salary is one component of Swiftly's total compensation package, which also includes stock options, competitive benefits, 401(k)/RRSP matching, and other perks.

  • US: $150,975 - $201,300 USD OTE
  • Canada: $158,523 - $211,365 CAD OTE

Beyond the Skills:

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about mobility, sustainability, or mission-oriented projects that have a significant real-world impact. Ideal candidates encompass the core values of our company:
• Team. Together, we are more effective and better supported
• Impact. Drive impact for our customers, our company, and all of our teams
• Diversity. See differing perspectives as ways to address our weaknesses and find new strengths
• Communication. Assume others internally and externally have good intentions
• Feedback. We share feedback because we want each other to grow professionally and personally
• Growth. Foster personal, professional, and company growth

Benefits:

• Competitive salary
• Equity compensation for every employee
• Medical, Dental and Vision
• Retirement with Employer Match
• Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
• Home office setup reimbursement
• Monthly cell/internet reimbursement
• Monthly "Be Well" stipend
• Flexible PTO with a recommended minimum
• Flexible work environment
• 16 paid holidays, including holidays in months without US national holidays
• 12 fully paid weeks of leave for child birth/adoption
Travel note: Swiftly employees can generally expect to travel 1–2 times a year for in-person company or team offsites. As a fully distributed company, we consider these offsites important for cultivating strong relationships across our teams! Attending these in-person is expected and encouraged, although we understand everyone has different personal circumstances and we will consider requests for exceptions. Customer-facing team members and other specific roles may be expected to travel more frequently.
We are a truly mission-driven culture that is set to change the world of transit
We are an equal opportunity employer - we are committed to a workplace that is as dynamic, diverse, and passionate as the communities we serve.
Because we work with public agencies, we participate in E-Verify.

Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we help the best and brightest of Sri Lanka to take advantage of opportunities that otherwise wouldn’t be available to them, while supporting entrepreneurs around the world. Our community (we call them Divers) don’t do surface work—they go deep to solve complex challenges and make a real impact. And in doing so, they support bold ideas, expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers, all without having to leave family and friends.

As an Automation Engineer (SEO), you will play a critical role in helping a growing digital marketing agency scale its SEO and marketing operations through automation, AI, and systems thinking. You'll work closely with leadership to design and implement technical solutions that reduce manual effort, improve execution speed, and create operational leverage across the business.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, building systems from the ground up, and leveraging modern technologies to streamline complex workflows. Rather than functioning as a traditional SEO specialist focused on rankings and campaign execution, you'll act as a technical operations partner who develops the infrastructure, automations, and AI-enabled workflows that make large-scale marketing execution possible.

Accountability

Your success as an Automation Engineer (SEO) will be defined by your ability to design scalable systems, automate repetitive processes, and transform operational challenges into efficient technical solutions.

Here's how you'll make an impact:

Automation & Workflow Engineering

  • Design and implement automation workflows that reduce manual operational effort across SEO and marketing functions.
  • Build repeatable systems that support scalable marketing execution.
  • Automate data collection, processing, reporting, and operational workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and process redesign.
  • Develop systems that increase execution capacity while reducing operational complexity.

AI & Workflow Optimization

  • Utilize AI tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, and emerging technologies to improve operational efficiency.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that accelerate execution and decision-making.
  • Develop scalable systems that integrate AI into day-to-day operations.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance existing workflows through AI adoption.
  • Experiment with new approaches that leverage agentic and AI-enabled capabilities.

API & Systems Integration

  • Work with APIs to connect internal and external platforms.
  • Build and maintain integrations across multiple software systems.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues and maintain the reliability of automation workflows.
  • Develop structured data flows that support operational objectives.
  • Ensure systems remain scalable, maintainable, and effective as the business grows.

Data Collection & Web Automation

  • Build and maintain web scraping solutions that support operational initiatives.
  • Develop browser automation workflows to streamline execution.
  • Extract, clean, and organize data from multiple sources.
  • Monitor automation performance and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Improve the reliability and scalability of data collection processes.

Technical Operations & Problem Solving

  • Translate ambiguous business requirements into structured technical solutions.
  • Independently manage multiple projects, priorities, and competing initiatives.
  • Recommend improvements to automation strategies and technical processes.
  • Act as a trusted technical problem solver across operational challenges.
  • Proactively identify inefficiencies and implement solutions that drive measurable impact.

Colleagues

You'll work closely with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to identify operational bottlenecks, implement scalable solutions, and improve the efficiency of marketing execution.

At Oceans Talent, you'll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you're continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans Talent, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area paired with broad curiosity across the business. raw.description:
Company Overview

Pearl West is a leading eCommerce investment and operating group specializing in acquiring, optimizing, and scaling premium brands. Our mission is to build and grow standout online businesses, and our websites are at the heart of delivering an exceptional customer experience.

As we continue to expand our digital capabilities, we're looking for a driven, results-focused Full-Stack Developer / Shopify Expert to take ownership of our site performance and conversion rates. This is an opportunity to work directly on high-traffic Shopify stores, make fast, meaningful changes, and directly impact revenue.

Role Overview

The Full-Stack Developer / Shopify Expert will be responsible for proactively identifying, testing, and implementing improvements to our Shopify storefronts and landing pages with a sharp focus on boosting conversion rates, site speed, and customer experience. This is not a hands-off, request-only position — we’re seeking someone who lives and breathes optimization and thrives in a fast-paced, ownership-driven environment.

Your success will be measured by tangible improvements to conversion rates, customer experience scores, and overall site performance metrics.

This is a full-time, remote role, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere while staying closely aligned with our growth-focused team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and implement front-end and back-end improvements to Shopify-based websites and landing pages
  • Run A/B tests, user experience optimizations, and CRO experiments independently
  • Optimize page speed, mobile responsiveness, and checkout flow performance
  • Build custom features, sections, and pages within Shopify’s Liquid framework and via third-party apps as needed
  • Analyze site metrics, heatmaps, and customer behavior tools to proactively surface opportunities for improvement
  • Work closely with design, marketing, and product teams to translate ideas into functional, tested, high-performance web solutions
  • Stay up to date on Shopify platform updates, app ecosystem changes, and eCommerce CRO best practices
  • Maintain clean, well-documented code and follow internal development workflows
  • Track, report, and iterate based on the results of tests and site improvement

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Conversion Rate Lift – Measurable improvement in store conversion rates over baseline
  • Site Speed Performance – Maintain or improve core web vitals and page load times
  • Implementation Velocity – Speed of independently completing and deploying optimizations
  • Testing Cadence – Number of proactive A/B tests and optimization initiatives launched per quarter
  • Bug Resolution Time – Timely identification and resolution of site issues
  • Documentation and Code Quality – Maintain clean, organized, and well-commented code for handoffs and scalin

Success Benchmarks (30-60-90 Days)

First 30 Days

  • Complete onboarding on brand sites, tech stack, and optimization priorities
  • Audit existing Shopify setups and propose immediate quick-win improvements
  • Take ownership of resolving minor site issues and performance bugs
  • Launch your first A/B test or optimization project with measurable results
  • Implement key CRO improvements to landing pages or product pages

First 60 Days

  • Collaborate with marketing on a conversion-focused landing page refresh
  • Deliver measurable conversion rate improvements from your initiatives
  • Establish a consistent optimization and testing pipeline
  • Become the go-to technical resource for Shopify development and CRO implementatio

Required Skills & Qualifications

Must-Have Skills:

  • 3+ years of hands-on Shopify development experience
  • Proficiency in Liquid, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Shopify APIs
  • Experience with Shopify theme customization, app integrations, and custom section builds
  • Proven track record of driving measurable eCommerce conversion rate improvements
  • Strong understanding of website performance optimization and core web vitals
  • Ability to independently run A/B tests, analyze results, and iterate
  • Detail-oriented with clean, organized coding practices
  • Proactive, driven, and ownership-focused — thrives without constant oversight

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience with Klaviyo, Google Analytics, and heatmapping tools (e.g., Clarity, Hotjar, Lucky Orange)
  • Familiarity with headless Shopify setups or Shopify Hydrogen
  • UI/UX design skills or ability to collaborate closely with design teams
  • Experience in eCommerce growth marketing environment

Who Should Apply

Apply if you:

  • Love working in fast-paced, high-ownership eCommerce environments
  • Constantly look for ways to improve site performance and conversions
  • Prefer proactively testing ideas over waiting for requests
  • Are organized, self-directed, and results-focused

Do not apply if you:

  • Require constant hand-holding or micromanagement
  • Prefer working reactively instead of proactively seeking improvements
  • Lack eCommerce experience or familiarity with Shopify

Why Join Pearl West

  • Own Your Impact – Work on high-traffic brands where your improvements directly influence business performance
  • Growth-Driven Environment – Join a results-obsessed, testing-centric team
  • Remote-First Culture – Work from anywhere with flexible hours
  • Learn and Scale – Stay on the cutting edge of Shopify and eCommerce CRO trends

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: TBA (commensurate with experience)
  • Bonus Structure: Performance-based bonuses tied to conversion improvements and project delivery
  • Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
  • Health & Wellness Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, mental health support
  • Additional Perks: Flexible PTO, company retreats, learning stipends

Application Process

  1. Submit Your Application – Send your resume, portfolio, and a short note about your favorite CRO project you’ve worked on
  2. Technical Assessment – Complete a brief code challenge and CRO scenario review
  3. Screening Call – Meet with our hiring manager to discuss your experience and fit
  4. Final Interview – Meet with leadership and marketing leads to review priorities and vision

Company Description

Swiftly is on a mission to help cities move more efficiently. We are the leading transit data platform for agencies to share real-time passenger information, manage day-to-day operations, and improve service performance. Today, over 200 transit agencies in 12 countries – including LA Metro, MARTA, SEPTA, and MBTA – rely on Swiftly to improve on-time performance by up to 40% and increase passenger information accuracy by up to 50%. The result is better service reliability, increased ridership, and more efficient transit operations.
Even though Swiftly's HQ office is located in San Francisco, CA, we are open to candidates in most locations across the U.S. as well as Ontario and British Columbia, Canada. At this time we are unable to provide Visa sponsorship.

About the Role

Swiftly is seeking an exceptional Sales Manager, SMB to lead and develop our SMB Account Executive team. This is a management role focused on building, coaching, and developing a high-performing sales team — ideal for a sales leader who thrives on developing reps, driving accountability, and winning in the public-sector transit market. We're in a period of growth and are building the go-to-market team that will define our next chapter. If you're passionate about developing talent, winning in a high-velocity SMB sales environment, and making public transit better for millions of riders, we want to talk to you.

As Sales Manager, SMB, you will lead a team of 5 SMB Account Executives driving new logo acquisition with small and mid-size transit agencies across North America. Your AEs build and manage territory plans, prospect a significant share of their own pipeline, run discovery calls and platform demos, build ROI-driven business cases, and guide government agencies through procurement to close — typically on 3 to 8 month sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and government procurement processes. You'll be responsible for hiring, onboarding, coaching, and developing these reps while setting the coaching rhythm, building pipeline strategy, and ensuring the team executes with discipline using the SPICED methodology. You'll also partner with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to align on strategy and improve the buyer experience.

Sales at Swiftly

Our Sales team is responsible for introducing Swiftly's platform to transit agencies and helping them understand how our real-time data, historical insights, and operational analytics can transform their service. We sell to government agencies with consultative sales cycles that require thorough discovery, strong relationships, and a genuine passion for improving public transit. Every deal matters — not just for revenue, but because each new agency means better service for the riders who depend on it.

To ensure we are making an impact throughout the sales process, we use a value-driven sales methodology. Our GTM teams are trained on the SPICED methodology, which serves as a blueprint for achieving sales targets, and we expect our sales managers to coach and reinforce it across their teams.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership and Coaching

  • Recruit, onboard, and develop a high-performing team of SMB Account Executives.
  • Establish and maintain a coaching rhythm: regular 1:1s, call reviews, deal reviews, and skills development sessions.
  • Set clear performance expectations and hold the team accountable to activity metrics, pipeline targets, and quota attainment.
  • Foster a culture of learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement across the team.

Pipeline and Revenue

  • Own the team's pipeline generation strategy, ensuring AEs prospect approximately 50 to 60% of their own pipeline through outbound calling, email campaigns, and tools such as LinkedIn.
  • Drive disciplined territory planning and account prioritization across the SMB segment.
  • Support AEs in navigating public-sector deals with typical 3 to 8 month sales cycles, multiple stakeholders, and government procurement processes.
  • Actively join AEs on discovery calls, demos, and business case development when needed.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline reporting in Salesforce; provide weekly forecast updates to leadership using Swiftly's forecast methodology.
  • Achieve and exceed team revenue goals.

Process and Strategy

  • Champion and enforce the SPICED sales methodology across the team.
  • Coach the team on identifying and mitigating deal risk, partnering with leadership, internal partners, and executives as needed.
  • Oversee Swiftly's responses to public solicitations within your team's territories, with the support of our internal procurement team.
  • Represent Swiftly at industry conferences (APTA, TransITech, state transit associations) and coach your team on event strategy.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to refine messaging, share market feedback, and improve the buyer experience.
  • Lead the adoption of AI-assisted and modern sales workflows that improve prospecting efficiency and sales effectiveness.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with at least 3 years in a frontline sales management role.
  • Experience scaling an SMB sales team is a strong plus.
  • Proven track record of leading teams to meet or exceed quota in a new-logo sales environment.
  • Strong coaching instincts — you develop reps, not just manage them.
  • Experience with consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and procurement processes.
  • Comfortable with government or public-sector sales; transit industry experience is a plus but not required.
  • Proficient with Salesforce, Gong Engage, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and modern sales tools.
  • Excellent communication skills — you can lead a team meeting, run a deal review, and present to executives with equal confidence.
  • Willingness to travel for conferences, team events, and strategic customer meetings.

Pay Range

In accordance with pay transparency laws, the approximate salary ranges for this position are listed below. These ranges represent the anticipated low and high end of the salary. Actual salaries will vary based on final role leveling, relevant experience, and geographic location. Salary is one component of Swiftly's total compensation package, which also includes stock options, competitive benefits, 401(k)/RRSP matching, and other perks.

  • US: $150,975 - $201,300 USD OTE
  • Canada: $158,523 - $211,365 CAD OTE

Beyond the Skills:

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about mobility, sustainability, or mission-oriented projects that have a significant real-world impact. Ideal candidates encompass the core values of our company:
• Team. Together, we are more effective and better supported
• Impact. Drive impact for our customers, our company, and all of our teams
• Diversity. See differing perspectives as ways to address our weaknesses and find new strengths
• Communication. Assume others internally and externally have good intentions
• Feedback. We share feedback because we want each other to grow professionally and personally
• Growth. Foster personal, professional, and company growth

Benefits:

• Competitive salary
• Equity compensation for every employee
• Medical, Dental and Vision
• Retirement with Employer Match
• Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
• Home office setup reimbursement
• Monthly cell/internet reimbursement
• Monthly "Be Well" stipend
• Flexible PTO with a recommended minimum
• Flexible work environment
• 16 paid holidays, including holidays in months without US national holidays
• 12 fully paid weeks of leave for child birth/adoption
Travel note: Swiftly employees can generally expect to travel 1–2 times a year for in-person company or team offsites. As a fully distributed company, we consider these offsites important for cultivating strong relationships across our teams! Attending these in-person is expected and encouraged, although we understand everyone has different personal circumstances and we will consider requests for exceptions. Customer-facing team members and other specific roles may be expected to travel more frequently.
We are a truly mission-driven culture that is set to change the world of transit
We are an equal opportunity employer - we are committed to a workplace that is as dynamic, diverse, and passionate as the communities we serve.
Because we work with public agencies, we participate in E-Verify.

raw.description:
About the Position

The Principal, Consultant is a senior-level technical leader responsible for delivering complex, multi-discipline projects and serving as a trusted subject matter expert within your discipline. You may serve as the Project Lead on selected projects, where you’ll be accountable for delivering work profitably, maintaining alignment with scope, and evaluating project health regularly to identify risks early and keep work on track.
You’ll lead discipline-specific design efforts, elevate quality, and ensure coordinated, high-performance project delivery across teams. You’ll document client-specific processes and deviations from TEECOM standards to support onboarding, delegation, and consistent delivery.
You’ll strengthen TEECOM’s foundations by modeling best practices, contributing to discipline documentation, authoring Pull Requests, and supporting improvements to tools, standards, and workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with Group Leads, Team Leads to ensure consistent application of standards and to resolve challenges.
Externally, you’ll cultivate strong client relationships—serving as a trusted technical advisor through clear communication, reliable execution, and sound engineering judgment. You’ll also contribute to pursuits and interviews, shape technical narratives, and participate in client discussions that strengthen TEECOM’s credibility and help win strategic work. Internally, you’ll mentor engineers and production team members by providing technical guidance, design reviews, and actionable feedback that improves project outcomes and supports their growth. While not a people manager, you play a key role in developing TEECOM’s capability and strengthening discipline excellence.
This position reflects strong technical expertise, reliable project leadership, disciplined execution, and a commitment to strengthening TEECOM’s standards, systems, and delivery.

Technical Leadership, Mentorship, and Improving the TEECOM System

  • As a Principal, Consultant, your impact comes from strong technical leadership, supporting the development of others, and contributing to improvements in TEECOM’s systems and discipline practices. You contribute in three key ways:

    • Technical Leadership

  • You elevate project outcomes by leading technical decisions and ensuring design quality, coordination, and documentation meet TEECOM’s standards.
  • You guide Designers, engineers, and production team members by providing clear rationale, helping them navigate design challenges, and reinforcing disciplined workflows.
  • You build trust with clients through clear communication, reliable follow-through, and a strong command of your discipline.

    • Mentor and Support Engineers

  • You strengthen project teams by coaching engineers and Designers, developing their judgment, and helping them improve design clarity and documentation quality.
  • When serving as a Mentor, you broaden your mentee’s experience by involving them in client conversations, site walks, design reviews, and documentation discussions.
  • You accelerate their growth by setting clear expectations, delegating meaningful work, and providing timely, constructive feedback—including through participation in quarterly performance assessments.

    • Improve the TEECOM System

  • You reinforce firmwide consistency by contributing to discipline standards, templates, and documentation through clear, well-organized Pull Requests.
  • You identify workflow or coordination gaps and propose improvements that enhance clarity, efficiency, and scalability.
  • You capture client nuances, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen onboarding, delegation, and cross-team alignment.

What Success in this Position Looks Like

  • You deliver coordinated, accurate, and well-documented discipline-specific and multi-discipline work on time, on budget, and to TEECOM’s quality standards.
  • You identify risks early, communicate them clearly, and make sound decisions that minimize rework and maintain project momentum.
  • You maintain strong utilization and contribute to financially successful projects within the scope and expectations set by the Project Lead or Group Lead.
  • You keep project documentation complete, accurate, and current—including design decisions, meeting notes, scope clarifications, and updates to the Design Decision Log (DDL).
  • You build client trust through clear communication and reliable follow-through, supporting pursuits by providing scope input, drafting or refining discipline fee proposals, and participating in interviews when needed.
  • You actively participate in client relationship development through networking events and conferences, direct outreach to clients and partners, and sharing intel gathered through documented interactions.
  • You strengthen TEECOM’s system by offering constructive feedback on templates, tools, and workflows and by contributing targeted Pull Requests that improve clarity and consistency.
  • You mentor Designers, engineers, and production team members through hands-on guidance, markups, and feedback that build judgment and strong documentation habits.
  • When paired as a Mentor, you meet regularly with your mentee, involve them in meaningful project activities, delegate with clear expectations, and contribute performance input to support their development.
  • You contribute to team and discipline knowledge through design reviews, internal discussions, and sharing lessons learned.
  • You stay current with industry trends and manufacturer updates and share relevant insights with your teams.
  • You collaborate effectively with Project Leads, Group Leads, and cross-discipline teammates to resolve coordination issues and support high-quality delivery.
  • You model TEECOM’s Core Values—Care, Trust, and Value—through communication, documentation, teamwork, and technical execution.
  • You are recognized by your teams as a reliable contributor whose work elevates design quality and project outcomes.

Responsibilities and Expectations

  • These responsibilities and expectations represent what is required to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.

    • Annual and Quarterly

  • Partner with Project Leads, Group Leads, and Team Leads to strengthen delivery consistency, coordination strategy, and discipline standards across projects.
  • Maintain visibility into project financial performance, scope alignment, and delivery health—identifying risks early and recommending adjustments that protect profitability and predictable outcomes.
  • Contribute to annual business planning by identifying client needs, emerging opportunities, and discipline trends that inform TEECOM’s strategy.
  • Support client relationship development through business reviews, strategic discussions, and participation in pursuits that strengthen long-term partnerships.
  • Lead or contribute to technical design reviews and QA/QC efforts that reinforce TEECOM standards, documentation clarity, and coordinated delivery.
  • Strengthen TEECOM’s system through targeted Pull Requests, documentation updates, and captured lessons learned that improve discipline workflows and scalability.
  • Collaborate on workload forecasting, resource planning, and delivery standards that support cross-team alignment and delivery predictability.
  • Contribute to discipline knowledge-sharing through training sessions, internal workshops, conferences, or TEECOM University participation.
  • When serving as a Mentor, provide structured performance input and development guidance that strengthens technical growth and leadership readiness.

    • Monthly and Biweekly

  • Lead discipline design, coordination, and documentation efforts—ensuring alignment with TEECOM standards, client expectations, and project objectives.
  • Maintain visibility into project schedules, staffing assumptions, and scope alignment—adjusting plans as needed to protect quality, profitability, and delivery momentum.
  • Lead or participate in key client and coordination meetings, documenting critical decisions, risks, and deviations in the Design Decision Log (DDL) and project tools.
  • Conduct or contribute to design reviews and QA/QC efforts that reinforce coordination integrity and technical excellence.
  • Advance discipline standards and workflows through targeted Pull Requests and documentation updates that improve clarity and onboarding consistency.
  • Support pursuits by refining discipline scope assumptions, technical strategies, and fee inputs to align with delivery realities.
  • Maintain financial accountability by supporting billing clarity, scope validation, AR follow-up, and accurate time and expense reporting.
  • When serving as a Mentor, delegate meaningful responsibility, provide structured feedback, and reinforce technical judgment and documentation discipline.

    • Weekly and Daily

  • Maintain alignment across projects by participating in coordination, client, and internal team meetings—clarifying priorities, surfacing risks early, and supporting forward momentum.
  • Lead technical guidance through design reviews, markups, and real-time feedback that strengthen coordination, documentation clarity, and delivery quality.
  • Maintain disciplined documentation across GitHub, Asana, Callback One, and the Design Decision Log (DDL)—ensuring decisions, client nuances, and coordination outcomes remain clear and traceable.
  • Support pursuits and active project work by refining scope assumptions, design strategies, and technical direction that align with TEECOM standards and client expectations.
  • Communicate proactively with clients, design partners, and contractors to resolve issues, maintain alignment, and keep projects moving forward.
  • Monitor project health—including scope alignment, schedules, deliverable quality, and coordination readiness—and recommend adjustments when risks emerge.
  • Execute discipline design, coordination, and technical decision-making with strong judgment while reinforcing TEECOM workflows and documentation practices.
  • Maintain accurate time, expense, and project updates that support forecasting, billing, and delivery visibility.

    • As Needed

  • Support Additional Service Agreements (ASAs), scope adjustments, and proposal development to maintain alignment between delivery realities and contractual expectations.
  • Strengthen client relationships by participating in strategic discussions, industry events, and outreach that supports long-term partnerships and future opportunities.
  • Contribute to recruiting, mentoring, and team development through interviews, coaching, and participation in internal initiatives that strengthen TEECOM’s discipline capability.
  • Conduct site visits, field verifications, and programming sessions as required, documenting findings clearly to support coordinated delivery.
  • Contribute to TEECOM’s thought leadership and marketing efforts by sharing technical insights, lessons learned, or project-based content.
  • Support cross-team delivery during high-demand periods or complex project phases to maintain firmwide alignment and momentum.

Supervisory / Mentorship / Training Responsibilities

  • Supervisory: When serving as a Mentor, you provide structured coaching and quarterly performance feedback for assigned mentees. You support discipline execution across projects by aligning Designers, engineers, and production team members with priorities, scope, and TEECOM standards, while surfacing dependencies, risks, and resourcing needs to Project Leads, Group Leads, or Team Leads for broader action.
  • Mentorship: Provide advanced technical guidance and design direction to Designers, engineers, and production team members. When paired as a Mentor, you broaden your mentee’s experience through design reviews, client discussions, and complex coordination challenges, reinforcing strong engineering judgment, documentation habits, and disciplined workflows.
  • Training: Contribute to discipline training by sharing lessons learned, participating in internal reviews, and supporting the development of training resources that improve technical consistency and delivery quality across teams.

Experience and Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical preferred), Architecture, or a related field; or equivalent technical experience.
  • Experience: 8+ years of experience in AEC or related professional services with strong discipline-specific capability. (ICT, Security, Physical Security, Electronic Security)
  • Demonstrated experience delivering coordinated, high-quality designs and making sound decisions within your discipline.
  • Ability to lead discipline-specific portions of complex, multi-stakeholder projects with minimal oversight.
  • Strong understanding of project delivery workflows, client expectations, documentation standards, and coordination requirements.
  • Experience contributing to documentation updates, design standards, and QA/QC workflows through GitHub or similar platforms.
  • Proficiency in Autodesk (AutoCAD, Revit), Bluebeam Studio, Microsoft 365 Suite, Google Workspace, and GitHub.
    • Industry certifications preferred by discipline:
  • PSP and/or CPP (Security) — preferred
  • CDT — preferred
  • EIT — plus
  • PE — plus
  • PMP — plus

Physical Demands

  • These physical demands represent what is required to perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations will be provided as needed.
  • Prolonged desk work using a computer, keyboard, mouse, and telephone.
  • Regular reading, writing, and communication in virtual and in-person settings.
  • Occasional travel to client sites for meetings, surveys, or inspections.
  • Site walks may require standing or walking for extended periods, climbing stairs, and navigating construction or utility areas.
  • Field activities may involve bending, kneeling, or maneuvering in confined spaces.
  • May occasionally lift or move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds.

Work Environment

  • These work environment characteristics represent the conditions encountered while performing essential job functions. Reasonable accommodations will be provided as needed.
  • Approximately 75% of work is performed in a remote or office environment using standard office equipment.
  • Approximately 25% occurs at client sites, including construction environments and existing facilities.
  • Construction sites may include exposure to elevated noise levels, dust, uneven or unfinished walking surfaces, variable lighting conditions, and active construction operations.
  • Utility rooms and similar spaces may have restricted access or may not fully comply with ADA accessibility standards. When access limitations exist, TEECOM will support coordinating reasonable accommodations with site-controlling contractor or alternative means to perform essential job functions.
  • All accidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions must be reported immediately to the site superintendent and internally to People Operations.
Your level will be evaluated and determined during the interview process.
We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.
NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES: Please note that TEECOM does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Recruitment Fee Agreement, TEECOM will not consider or agree to payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without a previously signed agreement, TEECOM explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of TEECOM.

raw.description:
We are looking for a seasoned software engineer who is passionate about creating next-generation healthcare software that will dramatically improve the lives of patients, clinicians, and caregivers. This person will write critical, significant portions of the code behind a brand new software product.
The ideal candidate has experience building SaaS and/or Cloud Native software for a regulated industry. Additionally, the Senior Software Engineer will bring expertise in one or more technologies including React, TypeScript, Go, Ent, gRPC, Twirp, and/or AWS technologies like EventBridge and Aurora. Sharing knowledge and mentoring members of a growing team will be key.
The Senior Software Engineer should enjoy working in an Agile collaborative environment with product managers, designers, external partners, and other engineers to build a high quality, consumer-oriented product from the ground up.

About Tendo

Make an impact—join our team!
We’re a fast-growing, mission-driven company building a culture that enables teams and individuals to thrive. Our team-driven culture and rapid growth have earned us recognition as one of Forbes’ Top Startup Employers for both 2024 and 2025. Led by an experienced and proven team, we live by our values and are always on the hunt for motivated people with diverse experiences and backgrounds to help us improve the care journey for patients, clinicians, and caregivers by creating software that provides seamless, intuitive, and user-friendly experiences.
If you like working with innovative technologies and want to be part of a growing team that will help transform the healthcare experience, we encourage you to apply today!

Job Location

Tendo has hubs in San Francisco, CA; San Diego, CA; Salt Lake City, UT; Chicago, IL; Nashville, TN; and Philadelphia, PA. Candidates may be located in any one of our hub locations.

Responsibilities

  • Drive all phases of software development including requirements analysis, architecture/design, implementation, documentation, testing, and debugging for a large consumer-facing application with significant daily usage.
  • Collaborate with product owners and designers to understand user needs and translate wireframes and other requirements into technical requirements and detailed architecture.
  • Participate in Agile processes including sprint planning, daily standups, demos, and retrospectives.
  • Learn and use Go and potentially other back end languages, along with technologies and frameworks like gRPC/Twirp, Ent, and various AWS technologies, to produce, modify, and maintain APIs, microservices, event streams/queues, and similar.
  • Write automated tests for all code and use Behavior Driven Development practices.
  • Write infrastructure as code using Serverless Framework.
  • Perform code reviews.
  • Provide expertise in Web, API, database, and/or cloud technologies and frameworks, including React, TypeScript, Go, gRPC, Twirp, Ent, Serverless Framework, and/or AWS technologies like EventBridge and Aurora.
  • Provide guidance, mentorship, and subject matter expertise to other team members.
  • Create technical documentation describing architecture decisions.
  • Support and implement the latest standards in securing data to meet HIPAA requirements.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (BS/BA) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar major OR equivalent professional experience or software development certification (including bootcamp).
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Professional experience developing Cloud Native applications/products on AWS, Azure, or GCP (AWS preferred) OR professional experience with Go/Golang OR professional experience with React + TypeScript.
  • Ability to communicate designs and work with product managers, engineers, and QA to clarify and prune requirements.
  • Professional experience with modern version control systems (e.g., Git) and tools (e.g., Bitbucket, GitHub, GitLab).

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a startup environment.
  • Knowledge of the healthcare industry and HL7 standards like FHIR.
  • Experience writing infrastructure as code using Serverless Framework.
  • Experience with graph data modeling (i.e., using Ent).
  • Experience with event streaming frameworks (i.e., EventBridge).
  • Experience with gRPC/Twirp.
  • AWS certification(s).

    • Base Salary Range

    $110,500-$149,500
    This salary range is offered with the understanding that final compensation is based on a number of factors including geography and experience. Tendo also offers an equity package, annual bonuses, and benefits.

    Benefits

    For full time employees, Tendo also offers full health benefits (medical, dental, and vision), flexible spending and health savings accounts, company paid life insurance, company paid short-term and long-term disability, company equity, voluntary benefits, 401(k), company paid holidays, flexible time off, and an employee wellness program (“Breathe”).
Tendo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.
